title: Finish nutrition enrichment (LLM provider) + meal-log medallion redesign
description:
Pause point for nutrition app work. Branch: feat/nutrition-frontend-enrichment.
Design doc: docs/nutrition-meal-log-design.md (medallion redesign + §11 loading, §4 determinism, §5 normalization, §6 recompute).

== DONE on this branch (committed) ==
1. Web UI same-origin on :8080 (apps/nutrition/public/index.html); appkit serveHttp gained opt-in { staticDir } (packages/appkit/src/index.ts) w/ /info metadata + path-traversal guard. notes/todo unaffected.
2. start.sh prints UI URL. Run via ./start.sh (Node 22 for better-sqlite3).
3. Phase-1 classification loading: seed.ts loads declarative files from apps/nutrition/data/ (nutrients.json, ingredients.json, component_mappings.json, ingredient_nutrients.csv, dataset.json) via validated, FK-ordered, idempotent loader. Behavior identical (6/8/30). 69/69 passed.
4. External enrichment (lazy fill-in):
   - src/nutrition_source.ts: NutritionProvider iface + usdaProvider (USDA FDC; USDA_FDC_API_KEY, DEMO_KEY fallback).
   - src/llm_source.ts: llmProvider via Anthropic SDK (claude-opus-4-8, json_schema output, thinking off, effort low). DYNAMIC import of @anthropic-ai/sdk so default/tests dont need it.
   - src/operations.ts: enrichMeal(db, mealId, provider) caches unmapped components into ingredients/component_ingredients/ingredient_nutrients (idempotent; net outside txn).
   - src/app.ts: registers enrich_meal; provider = NUTRITION_PROVIDER==llm ? llmProvider : usdaProvider (default USDA).
   - integration.test.ts: tool count 3->4, asserts enrich_meal.

== OUTSTANDING (next) ==
A. Unit test enrichMeal w/ FAKE provider (offline) in test/unit.test.ts (was mid-edit). import enrichMeal from ../src/operations.js + types from ../src/nutrition_source.js. unknown component -> enrich(fake) -> getMealNutrition shows nutrients; assert cached-skip on 2nd enrich.
B. npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk in apps/nutrition + add to package.json deps (NOT installed; dynamic import errors clearly if absent).
C. .env.example: add USDA_FDC_API_KEY + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (start.sh exports .env to apps).
D. Web UI: per-meal Fetch-nutrition button -> POST /enrich_meal {meal_id} -> re-render; improve empty-nutrition state.
E. Full suite under Node 22 (nvm use 22; cd apps/nutrition && npm test); confirm green.
F. E2E: ./start.sh, log exotic-component meal in UI, enrich (USDA), confirm nutrition; then NUTRITION_PROVIDER=llm w/ ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

== BIGGER follow-on (design doc, not started) ==
- Full bronze/silver/gold migration (meal_log, meal_templates, phrase_resolution, ingredient_aliases, source+confidence cols, materialized meal_nutrition_mat/daily_nutrition_mat + triggers). Enrichment currently writes the CURRENT schema.
- Build-time USDA seed ETL + offline LLM template batch (docs §11 phases 2-4).
- Normalization layers 0-4 + reference recompute (docs §5/§6).

NOTE: .beads metadata.json switched to dolt_mode=embedded (was server) so bd works without a standalone Dolt server. bd sync exports to JSONL for remote pickup.
